title: A query column holding a plain aggregate has the grand total in every row
query: DEFINE COLUMN Product[All Sales] = SUM ( Sales[Amount] )
EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Product, "Product", Product[Product], "All Sales", Product[All Sales] )

source.quote: The syntax after COLUMN defines a query column, which has a data lineage and it is populated in an empty filter context before the query is executed.
source.supports: the column is computed row by row in an empty filter context

source.quote: By using the SUMX expression, the context transition does not happen because the implicit CALCULATE around the measure reference is missing.
source.supports: an aggregation written out, unlike a measure reference, has no context transition

derivation: The column expression has a row context and an empty filter context. SUM ( Sales[Amount] ) has no CALCULATE, so the row does not filter Sales: 540 for every product.
